title: Forcing in bounded arithmetic and set theory: analogies and differences
summary: We provide a modern overview of several forcing methods in bounded arithmetic and compare them with forcing in set theory. We specifically discuss the countable forcing framework of Atserias and Muller, the restricted ultrapowers of Bydzovsky and Muller, and forcing with random variables developed by Krajicek. We illustrate these forcing arguments by reviewing the Paris--Wilkie forcing and by giving a self-contained construction of the shallow PHP model constructed by Krajicek.
